service.method: SELECT GWGL.APP_NO , GWGL.APP_NO_SEQ , GWGL.APP_TYPE AS HEADER_APP_TYPE , GWGL.APP_STATUS , GWGL.CURRENT_STAGE , GWLN.APP_LINE_SEQ , GWLN.APP_STAGE , GWLN.APP_TYPE , GWLN.APP_METHOD , GWLN.APP_LINE_STATUS , GWLN.APP_USER_ID , GWGL.SUX_WKEY1 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY2 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY3 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY4 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY5 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY6 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY7 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY8 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY9 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY10 FROM SGWGL GWGL with(nolock) INNER JOIN SGWLN GWLN with(nolock) ON GWGL.HOUSE_CODE = GWLN.HOUSE_CODE AND GWGL.COMPANY_CODE = GWLN.COMPANY_CODE AND GWGL.APP_NO = GWLN.APP_NO AND GWGL.APP_NO_SEQ = GWLN.APP_NO_SEQ WHERE GWGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND GWGL.COMPANY_CODE = ${SEPOA_APPROVAL_S_COMPANY_CODE} AND GWGL.APP_NO = ${APP_NO} AND GWGL.APP_NO_SEQ = ${APP_NO_SEQ} AND CONVERT(INT, ISNULL(GWGL.CURRENT_STAGE,'999')) <= CONVERT(INT, ISNULL(GWLN.APP_STAGE,'999')) ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, ISNULL(GWLN.APP_LINE_SEQ ,'999')) , CONVERT(INT, ISNULL(GWLN.APP_STAGE,'999'))
